##### Project general facts

Reem Hills is a wonderfully gated community offering an inspiring collection of villas, townhouses, and apartments designed for peak living. Residents can choose from spacious five, six, and seven-bedroom villas presented in four beautifully distinct architectural styles: Zen, Frame, Minimal, and Cubic. Every home is thoughtfully crafted with harmonious architectural lines that celebrate light, openness, and a true sense of tranquility.

The community is wonderfully equipped with an array of amenities that support a healthy, well-rounded lifestyle. Residents enjoy private pools, sandy beach access, inviting club houses, jogging and cycling tracks, and lush parks and playgrounds for the whole family to enjoy. Charming retail shops and delightful cafes and restaurants sit alongside the highest security technology, all within a beautifully landscaped, fully gated community.

Inside, homes are designed with a wonderful sense of spaciousness, featuring wide-open living areas, soaring ceilings, and expansive glass walls that invite the outdoors in. Interiors combine premium natural materials, elegant marble detailing, and warm wood accents for a refined yet welcoming atmosphere. Every finish has been thoughtfully selected to create an understated luxury that feels both intimate and effortlessly grand.

##### Location description and benefits 

Al Reem Island is a natural island located in the Arabian Gulf off the coast of Abu Dhabi. The island is connected to the mainland by several bridges, making it easily accessible.

The island has undergone significant development over the past decade and is now a thriving residential and commercial community. It is home to several high-rise residential buildings, as well as office towers, hotels, and shopping centers.

Al Reem Island is known for its luxurious and modern architecture, and many of its buildings offer stunning views of the surrounding sea and cityscape. The island also has several parks and recreational areas, as well as a marina and a promenade along the waterfront.
